summary: Iter15 retest of the CartTicket mutation bug from iter14. FIX WAS NOT APPLIED — /app/frontend/src/components/pos/register/CartTicket.jsx still contains the mutation pattern `lines[i].seat = ...`, `lines[i].qty = ...`, `lines[i].held = !...`. All three updaters (cycleSeat, qtyChange, toggleHold) reproduce the StrictMode double-invoke skip. Regression items (exclusivity locks, cash payment → receipt) verified working.

ui_bugs.issue: Seat cycle still skips values (guests=4 sequence observed: S1 → S3 → S1 → S3 → S1 across 4 individual clicks with 400ms between). Expected S1 → S2 → S3 → S4 → S1. Root cause identical to iter14: `lines[i].seat = (cur % guests) + 1` mutates the source line object; React.StrictMode double-invokes the updater and the second invocation sees the already-cycled value and cycles again. The claimed fix using `.map()` is NOT present in the current file (CartTicket.jsx lines 118-138 unchanged from iter14).

Qty +/- doubles every click in StrictMode due to same mutation pattern. Observed: initial qty=1 → after two +clicks qty=5 (expected 3) → after one -click qty=3 (expected 2). Same bug family as cycleSeat: `lines[i].qty = Math.max(1, lines[i].qty + d)` mutates line in place.

Hold toggle appears no-op in dev/StrictMode. Observed: before=False, after 1st click=False, after 2nd click=False. Explanation: `lines[i].held = !lines[i].held` mutates the same object, StrictMode double-invokes so the value flips twice back to original. In production this would work, but the pattern is still impure.

rca_of_the_issue: Same as iter14: shallow array copy `const lines = [...o.lines]` clones the array reference but the elements are still the same object references as in o.lines. Assigning `lines[i].field = X` mutates the object seen by React's StrictMode second invocation of the setState updater, causing the change to be applied twice. Fix: replace with `const lines = o.lines.map((ln, idx) => idx === i ? { ...ln, field: newValue } : ln)` in all three updaters.
